extracted.intended_audience: AI/ML researchers and practitioners working on reinforcement learning and storytelling (NLP/creative-writing)
extracted.subtask_description: Designing and evaluating reinforcement-learning pipelines and reward models to improve creative story generation from large language models, with emphasis on human-aligned rewards and training stability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with human creativity judgments
rubrics_metrics.description: GenRM achieves 68% alignment with human creativity judgments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an empirical metric of how well the generative reward model matches human preferences for creativity; reported as a percentage alignment with human judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-dimensional analysis of story preferences
rubrics_metrics.description: provides multi-dimensional analysis and explicit reasoning about story preferences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reward model should evaluate stories along multiple dimensions (not a single scalar) and articulate preference reasoning; supports richer, interpretable preference signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit reasoning via reasoning chains
rubrics_metrics.description: trained through supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations with reasoning chains distilled from strong teacher models
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reward modeling should incorporate explicit reasoning chains distilled from stronger models (teacher demonstrations) to ground the reward in interpretable rationale and improve quality of judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: GRPO-based refinement on expanded preference data
rubrics_metrics.description: followed by GRPO-based refinement on expanded preference data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After supervised fine-tuning, apply GRPO (a policy/optimization refinement) on larger preference datasets to further align the generative reward model with observed human preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entropy-based reward shaping to prioritize learning
rubrics_metrics.description: an entropy-based reward shaping strategy that dynamically prioritizes learning on confident errors and uncertain correct predictions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use entropy-informed shaping to focus training on examples where the model is confidently wrong or uncertain despite correctness, thereby improving learning efficiency and robustness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevent overfitting on already-mastered patterns
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training procedures and reward shaping should explicitly avoid over-optimizing for patterns the model already masters, to promote generalization and creative variation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design reliable reward signals for subjective storytelling quality
rubrics_metrics.description: designing reliable reward signals for subjective storytelling quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A core requirement: reward signals must capture subjective qualities of stories (creativity, preference) in a way that is consistent and usable for RL training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mitigate training instability in RL for storytelling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frameworks should address RL training instability (e.g., via reward shaping, constrained updates, or other stabilizing mechanisms) so that improvements in reward translate to stable policy improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empirical comparison to strong baselines on overall story quality
rubrics_metrics.description: RLCS significantly outperforms strong baselines including Gemini-2.5-Pro in overall story quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate end-to-end system improvements by comparing generated story quality (likely via human evaluation or established quality metrics) against strong baseline models.
